name: performance and resilience checkpoint

files.purpose: Bounded checkpoint timing, incremental hash delta summary, undo/redo revision race guards, projection failure retry guard, and label worker failure guard.
Targeted performance/resilience tests for incremental hashes, establish/split/dissolve planner smoke timing, undo race rejection, projection failure injection, and worker failure injection.

10-113.evidence: Incremental hash delta summaries count changed roots/leaves and verify touched leaves are less than total leaves for ownership-only changes.

10-114.evidence: country.split, country.establish, and country.dissolve planners are measured through bounded one-iteration smoke timing without long-running benchmarks.

10-115.evidence: Undo/redo revision guards reject stale race attempts and preserve the original history/state references when rejected.

10-116.evidence: Projection failure injection keeps the last good projection revision/artifact hash and recovers through latest revision retry.

10-117.evidence: Worker failure injection keeps point fallback labels and accepts a later successful glyph result.

10-118.evidence: Targeted tests, typecheck, lint, full unit suite, and diff whitespace checks all pass for the checkpoint.
